name: Volvo
intro: Volvo originated in Sweden. This course teaches selected recognizable model families, organized by the jobs they do. It is a guided starting map, not a claim that these are every current or historical model.
naming: Volvo originated in Sweden. XC names are SUV families; EX identifies newer electric SUV families. Similar numbers across XC and EX names do not guarantee identical bodies. Older S sedans and V wagons remain useful recognition names.
warning: The families below are selected for learning and recognition. Check the linked official range for current Canadian availability, model years, equipment and pricing. A familiar name may remain on used cars after new-car availability changes.

models.name: XC60
models.explanation: XC60 is a Volvo SUV family. Powertrain badges and plug-in branding have changed over time, so the family name is not a complete engine specification.
models.tradeoff: The XC60 belongs in a comparison for core volvo suv. Check actual passenger fit, cargo access, exterior dimensions and the exact version’s running costs. Its category is a starting point, not a promise that it fits every person or task.
models.compare: Compare XC60 with XC90 for larger seating needs and with an electric EX family only after checking the distinct vehicle and charging requirements.
models.scenario: A friend mentions a XC60. Explain its role as core volvo suv, then ask for the year, powertrain and equipment before comparing it with another Volvo.
models.power: Check the exact Canadian model year and version for the available engine, hybrid or electric system. Do not infer the powertrain from the family name alone.

models.name: XC90
models.explanation: XC90 is Volvo’s larger SUV family with a three-row role. It remains a separate family from the electric EX90.
models.tradeoff: The XC90 belongs in a comparison for larger volvo family suv. Check actual passenger fit, cargo access, exterior dimensions and the exact version’s running costs. Its category is a starting point, not a promise that it fits every person or task.
models.compare: Compare actual seat configurations, third-row access and luggage space. A shared 90 in XC90 and EX90 is not proof that their mechanical specifications are interchangeable.
models.memory: XC90 = larger SUV; EX90 = separate electric family
models.scenario: A friend mentions a XC90. Explain its role as larger volvo family suv, then ask for the year, powertrain and equipment before comparing it with another Volvo.
models.power: Check the exact Canadian model year and version for the available engine, hybrid or electric system. Do not infer the powertrain from the family name alone.

models.name: EX30
models.explanation: EX30 is Volvo’s smaller electric SUV family. Electric describes its energy source; small SUV describes its practical category. You need both ideas to place it correctly.
models.tradeoff: The EX30 belongs in a comparison for smaller volvo electric suv. Check actual passenger fit, cargo access, exterior dimensions and the exact version’s running costs. Its category is a starting point, not a promise that it fits every person or task.
models.compare: Compare the exact space and charging specification with other smaller EVs. A large screen or a long feature list is not evidence that the rear seat fits your passengers.
models.scenario: A friend mentions a EX30. Explain its role as smaller volvo electric suv, then ask for the year, powertrain and equipment before comparing it with another Volvo.
models.power: Check the exact Canadian model year and version for the available engine, hybrid or electric system. Do not infer the powertrain from the family name alone.
